_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide 7th Grade - Open Up EL Education, uploaded 8/31/26, transcribed by week (parsed from the guide's M | U | L labels and lesson titles, cross-checked against Appendix A's Grade 7 ELA bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md).
_note: Module = EL Education Module, Unit = the Unit within that Module (stored as a string; lesson numbers reset per Unit, as in Grades K-6). This guide runs the full 36 weeks with no early finish, matching Grades 4-6. Seven weeks cross a Unit boundary within the same Module - week 4 (Unit 1 to Unit 2), week 7 (Unit 2 to Unit 3), week 13 (Unit 1 to Unit 2), week 16 (Unit 2 to Unit 3), week 21 (Unit 1 to Unit 2), week 25 (Unit 2 to Unit 3), and week 34 (Unit 2 to Unit 3) - each split into two segments per the standing rule, more than any prior grade (Grade 6 had five). Every Module-to-Module transition (weeks 10, 19, 28) lands cleanly on a week boundary with no crossing. One guide table-header/body mismatch: week 33's header row reads 'Module 4 | Unit 3 | Take a Stand: Ways to Reduce Plastic Pollution', but every lesson in that week's body (L10-L14) is still M4|U2 by its own labels and lesson-number continuity from week 32's L5-L9 - the header names the unit the guide is about to reach, not the one the week's lessons are actually in. Transcribed as Unit 2, per the standing body-wins rule; Unit 3 doesn't actually begin until week 34's L1. Many lessons carry a duplicate '(Homework)' entry under the same lesson number (e.g. week 1's L2 and L2 (Homework), week 11's L8 and L8 (Homework)); these are deduped to a single lesson number rather than double-counted, and two-lesson multi-day assessments that genuinely span two different lesson numbers across a week boundary (e.g. weeks 5-6's Mid-Unit 2 Assessment at L5/L6, weeks 16-17's End/Mid-Unit transition) are kept as their own distinct lessons, not deduped. 'assessment' names any Mid-Unit / End-of-Unit Assessment or Performance Task falling within that segment's lessons - 'Mid-Unit'/'End of Unit'/'Part I/II' and colon detail are dropped, keeping only the base tag; a tag repeated across lessons in the same segment, or across two consecutive weeks for a multi-day assessment (e.g. weeks 24-25's End of Unit 2 Assessment Part I/II, weeks 32-33's End of Unit 2 Assessment Part I/II), is written once per segment - each week is its own segment here (no cross-week merging), so a spanning assessment's tag naturally appears in each week's own segment it touches, same as Grade 6. Four weeks (9, 18, 27, 36) carry two distinct assessment tags in one segment - a Unit Assessment tag plus a following 'Performance Task' lesson pair - joined with ' + ' in guide-text order, e.g. week 9: 'Unit 3 Assessment + Performance Task'. Confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 7 Open Up EL Education bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md, which for this grade already carry the same per-week breakdown as the guide itself (unlike the compressed one-line-per-LP ranges at other grades), reproducing the same lesson numbers, titles, and assessment labels verbatim at every week checked - zero real boundary mismatches found. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 with no gaps or duplicates across all twelve Module/Unit pairs (M1: 16, 14, 11 lessons; M2: 14, 15, 13; M3: 12, 16, 14; M4: 13, 15, 14), 167 lessons total.
